description: This file defines the business logic layer for task operations within a task management backend. It includes a service class 'TaskService' with methods for creating, retrieving, updating, toggling, and deleting tasks, enforcing user ownership and proper error handling. It interacts with the repository layer for database access.

classes.name: TaskService
classes.description: Service layer for task operations with ownership enforcement and business logic.

classes.name: TaskNotFoundError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when a task cannot be found or is not owned by the user.

methods.name: Task create_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, title: str, description: Optional[str])
methods.description: Creates a new task associated with a user.

methods.name: Sequence[Task] list_tasks(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 50)
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of tasks for a specific user.

methods.name: Task get_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a single task owned by the user; raises an error if not found.

methods.name: Task update_task( self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int, title: Optional[str], description: Optional[str], is_completed: Optional[bool], )
methods.description: Updates details of a specified task; raises error if task not found.

methods.name: Task toggle_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int, explicit_state: Optional[bool])
methods.description: Toggles or sets the completion status of a task; raises error if not found.

methods.name: None delete_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a specified task; raises error if task not found.
